subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 'Launch at login' stops sticking / appears to turn itself off after app updates

question: Should the macOS app persist an OpenClaw-owned Launch at login intent and re-register the app LaunchAgent after updates when launchd state drifts?
rationale: Current code treats live launchd state as authoritative, while the report asks for the user's enabled intent to survive app replacement; choosing the wrong default could either lose the setting or override an intentional OS-level disable.

options.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
options.body: Store enabled intent for the app-owned LaunchAgent and re-register after startup/update drift, while preserving a clear path for deliberate user disablement.

options.title: Keep launchd authoritative
options.body: Leave live launchd/System Settings state as the source of truth and adjust UI/docs so OpenClaw does not restore an externally disabled login item.

options.title: Wait for live update proof
options.body: Keep the issue parked until a packaged Sparkle update repro shows exactly which state flips before selecting the repair behavior.

recommendation.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
recommendation.body: Store enabled intent for the app-owned LaunchAgent and re-register after startup/update drift, while preserving a clear path for deliberate user disablement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the launchd-backed macOS launch checkbox and adjacent app state repairs.
